title: GPU Optimization
description: Maximize your graphics card performance with overclocking, driver tuning, and optimal NVIDIA/AMD control panel settings.

prerequisites.title: Before You Begin
items: Install latest GPU drivers from NVIDIA or AMD
Have a benchmarking tool ready (3DMark, Unigine Heaven)

steps.title: NVIDIA Control Panel Optimization
steps.content:
Optimize NVIDIA settings for maximum gaming performance.

**Access:** Right-click desktop → NVIDIA Control Panel

**Manage 3D Settings → Global Settings:**
• Image Sharpening: On (GPU Scaling enabled)
• Anisotropic Filtering: Application-controlled or 16x
• Low Latency Mode: Ultra (for competitive games)
• Max Frame Rate: Match your monitor refresh rate
• Power Management Mode: Prefer Maximum Performance
• Preferred Refresh Rate: Highest available
• Texture Filtering Quality: High Performance
• Threaded Optimization: Auto
• Triple Buffering: Off
• Vertical Sync: Off (use in-game or G-Sync instead)

**Set PhysX Configuration:**
Set to your discrete GPU, not Auto-select

infoBox.title: Per-Game Settings
infoBox.content: You can create per-game profiles with different settings. Useful for competitive games (lower quality, higher FPS) vs. single-player games (higher quality).

steps.title: AMD Radeon Software Optimization
steps.content:
Optimize AMD GPU settings for gaming.

**Access:** Right-click desktop → AMD Radeon Software

**Graphics → Global Graphics:**
• Radeon Anti-Lag: Enabled
• Radeon Chill: Off (unless you want power savings)
• Radeon Boost: On for supported games
• Radeon Image Sharpening: On (50-80%)
• Wait for Vertical Refresh: Off, unless application specifies

**Advanced Settings:**
• Anti-Aliasing: Use application settings
• Anisotropic Filtering: Enabled, 16x
• Texture Filtering Quality: Performance
• Surface Format Optimization: Enabled
• Tessellation Mode: Override application settings (8x or 16x)
• Frame Rate Target Control: Set to monitor refresh rate

steps.title: GPU Overclocking with MSI Afterburner
steps.content:
Safely overclock your GPU for extra performance.

**Initial Setup:**
1. Download MSI Afterburner from MSI website
2. Launch and familiarize with the interface
3. Set up monitoring (on-screen display) in settings

**Safe Overclocking Steps:**
1. **Power Limit**: Increase to maximum (usually +10-20%)
2. **Temperature Limit**: Set to 85-87°C
3. **Core Clock**: Start with +50 MHz
4. **Memory Clock**: Start with +100 MHz

**Testing Process:**
1. Apply settings
2. Run benchmark (3DMark, Unigine Heaven)
3. Monitor for artifacts or crashes
4. If stable, increase by small increments
5. If unstable, reduce last increase by 10-20 MHz

**Save Profile:**
Once stable, save to a profile slot for easy recall

infoBox.title: Laptop Thermal Limits
infoBox.content: Laptops have limited cooling compared to desktops. Start with conservative overclocks and monitor temperatures carefully. If temps exceed 85°C, reduce settings.

steps.title: GPU Undervolting
steps.content:
Reduce GPU temperatures while maintaining performance.

**NVIDIA Undervolting (MSI Afterburner):**
1. Press Ctrl+F to open voltage/frequency curve
2. Find your target frequency (e.g., 1800 MHz)
3. Drag that point down to a lower voltage
4. Select the point and press L to lock
5. Apply and test stability

**AMD Undervolting (Radeon Software):**
1. Open Radeon Software → Performance → Tuning
2. Enable "GPU Tuning"
3. Select "Undervolt GPU"
4. Or manually reduce voltage offset
5. Test with benchmarks

**Expected Results:**
• 5-15°C temperature reduction
• Same or better sustained performance
• Quieter fan operation
• Longer GPU lifespan

steps.title: Driver Optimization Tips
steps.content:
Keep your GPU drivers optimized:

**Driver Selection:**
• Use Game Ready (NVIDIA) or Recommended (AMD) drivers
• Studio drivers are for content creation, not gaming
• Beta drivers may have bugs - use stable releases

**Clean Driver Installation:**
1. Download latest driver
2. Use DDU (Display Driver Uninstaller) in Safe Mode
3. Install fresh driver
4. Reconfigure your settings

**NVIDIA GeForce Experience Tips:**
• Disable "Automatic Performance Tuning" if manually tuning
• Keep ShadowPlay/Instant Replay ready for captures
• Use "Optimal" settings only as a starting point

**Shader Cache:**
• Enable shader cache in driver settings
• Consider increasing cache size for SSDs
• Clear cache if experiencing stuttering

infoBox.title: Performance Gains
infoBox.content: Proper GPU optimization can yield 5-15% performance improvement through overclocking, plus significantly better thermals through undervolting.
